message.content: The new probe evidence is material: the c2/c3 sweeps found 4 negative finite FP16 inputs whose kernel output bit patterns differ from the reference oracle (not in the subnormal-output or underflow-to-zero categories — signed zeros both gave 0x3800 correctly, zero counts matched). This is exactly the failure condition already hypothesized by existing claim c1 (a legal input whose final FP16 bit pattern deviates from the oracle, violating the exact round-to-nearest-even requirement). Since c1 already covers this condition and the mismatch details are pending Experimenter interpretation of t16/t17, no new claim is warranted; I record that review outcome.
